{{Top|leg}}
The '''OCC-SI'''&mdash;short for '''Offensive Combat Command Strategic Intelligence'''&mdash;unit was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] module produced by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Derived from the strategic protocols used by Czerka [[Droid/Legends|droids]], the unit allowed [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to scan for enemy vulnerabilities and provide boost to nearby allies.
